name: cerberus-gate
description: Review final answers using session tools under instructions prohibiting side effects, and route corrections to the main agent.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: inherit, haiku, sonnet, opus, or a model ID.

maxRevisions.title: Maximum corrections
maxRevisions.description: Number of correction prompts per user request (0–10).

reviewTimeoutSeconds.title: Review timeout
reviewTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a review is treated as unverified (1–600).

reviewerEffort.title: Reviewer effort
reviewerEffort.description: inherit uses the main answer effort. Model support may limit the effective effort.

reviewPrompt.title: Review prompt
reviewPrompt.description: Replace the review criteria (up to 20,000 characters). Empty or whitespace uses the default. Read-only permissions and JSON protocol remain fixed.
